set.body: Roadmap for the next LSS layer. Goals: introduce a typed prepared-design/workspace boundary, enable chunked and future distributed execution through reusable prepared state, add typed block-result merging, and replace string-based trialwise aggregate inference with compile-time-visible design metadata. Acceptance: child issues cover prepared workspace, block merge/chunk parity, and explicit trial-column metadata.
set.title: Epic: Typed LSS execution layer
